overloads.semanticRole: SEND VARIABLE sends variable to the document or serial port previously opened by SET CHANNEL .

constraints: Requires a serial port or document previously opened via SET CHANNEL; cannot be used with a document opened via Open document, Create document, or Append document.
Sends the complete variable, including its type and value, in a special internal format readable only by RECEIVE VARIABLE.
Does not support array variables; use the BLOB Commands to send/receive arrays over a document or serial port.
